setupAnchorPromptEn: 9:16 Livestream Setup Reference Sheet (3-panel consistency anchor for host "ren.urban"): Panel 1 [0° Primary Live Frame]: 16mm ultra-wide action-cam rectilinear/mild barrel lens, deep focus f/5.6, both hands of the streamer visible entering lower frame, natural photorealistic human proportions and micro-skin texture, authentic five-finger hand anatomy with firm natural grip on phone/mic/props, real fabric folds, realistic smartphone/webcam sensor dynamic range, compact clip-on wireless lavalier microphone transmitter clipped to collar/lapel, tight volumetric handheld flashlight beam cutting through dim ambient corridor shadows, faint blue smartphone chat-screen spill on left hand, direct eye-contact into the lens as if greeting live chat; Panel 2 [15° Chat-Read Glance]: exact same room, outfit, and mic position, eyes flicked 15 degrees off-axis reading a glowing secondary chat monitor with subtle smile; Panel 3 [Rig & Optical Side Diagram]: clean side-view showing camera mount distance, ring-light placement, and room background props. Clean raw camera feed, zero burned-in UI text, zero platform watermarks.
setupAnchorPromptZh: 9:16 直播间跨镜头一致性三态锚定参考卡（主播「ren.urban」）：左格【0°主镜头直视态】：16mm超广角运动相机第一视角，f/5.6大景深，主播双手从画面下沿自然伸入互动，自然写实真人比例与真实皮肤微纹理，标准五指自然持握手机/麦克风/道具，真实衣物褶皱与手机/摄像头传感器动态范围，衣领处夹持一枚紧凑型无线领夹麦克风发射器，凝聚的手持强光手电筒光束切开幽暗走廊阴影，左手弹幕手机屏幕泛出微弱冷蓝光，眼神0°直视镜头向直播间观众打招呼；中格【15°偏轴读弹幕态】：完全相同的房间陈设、穿搭与麦克风左右位置，视线偏转15°扫向副屏弹幕并露出实时反应；右格【机位与补光侧视锚点】：清晰交代摄像头架设距离、环形灯/霓虹光源方位与背景固定摆件。画面保持100%纯净无UI文字底片，零平台水印、零乱码弹幕。
